header.name: Dr. Daniel Ben-Ami
header.subtitle: VP Engineering · Platform & Data · Scaling 0→1 and 1→N

summary: Engineering leader with fifteen years building and scaling platform, data, and ML infrastructure across fintech and cybersecurity. Track record of taking products from zero to production and growing teams from a handful of engineers to multiple cross-functional groups, while keeping reliability, cost, and developer velocity in balance.

professional_experiences.title: VP Engineering 1
bullets: Built and led a 60-person engineering organization across platform, data, and product groups, defining the hiring bar and the technical strategy that supported a 4x increase in transaction volume
Drove the migration from a monolith to a service-oriented architecture, cutting median deploy time from hours to under ten minutes and improving change-failure rate measurably
Introduced an SLO-based reliability program with error budgets, taking platform availability from 99.5% to 99.95% while reducing on-call burden
Partnered with finance to bring cloud spend under control, renegotiating commitments and re-architecting the data pipeline to cut monthly infrastructure cost by roughly a third
Established the engineering career framework and a structured promotion process adopted company-wide across all technical functions

professional_experiences.title: Director of Engineering 2
bullets: Owned the detection platform processing billions of security events per day, leading a group of four teams responsible for ingestion, enrichment, and real-time alerting
Shipped the company's first ML-based anomaly detection capability, working closely with data science to productionize models with reproducible training and monitoring
Scaled the team from twelve to thirty-five engineers while keeping attrition well below the industry benchmark through deliberate onboarding and mentoring
Led the response and post-mortem culture overhaul after a major incident, instituting blameless reviews that materially reduced repeat incidents

professional_experiences.title: Engineering Manager 3
bullets: Managed two product teams delivering the customer-facing claims experience used by hundreds of thousands of policyholders
Introduced continuous delivery and feature-flagging, enabling daily releases with safe rollbacks
Coached four engineers into senior roles and two into their first management positions

professional_experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer 4
bullets: Built core rendering infrastructure for the website editor serving millions of users, focused on performance and cross-browser correctness
Led the front-end performance guild, driving a measurable reduction in time-to-interactive across the editor
Mentored junior engineers and ran the internal JavaScript training series

professional_experiences.title: Software Engineer 5

Improved the policy-compilation pipeline, cutting build times for large rule sets
Contributed to the migration of legacy C++ modules toward a more testable architecture
